name: proto-facts-unevaluated-before-serializers
description: An analyzer that runs the carrier sweep before every rule that can change a published state applies writes evaluated false, so its consumer records carry no state: the field hand code reads and the field it only writes are both published without one, and the merge reads each live.
pending: bindings.10: deadset-ts runs the carrier sweep and keeps evaluated false until the serializer rules apply (J6); the packet that writes evaluated true (J7) replaces this expectation.
